Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, s As String, i As Long
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6))
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnStacked
    Case 1
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnStacked100
    Case 2
        ch.ChartType = xlBarStacked
    Case 3
        ch.ChartType = xlBarStacked100
    Case 4
        ch.ChartType = xlLineStacked
    Case 5
        ch.ChartType = xlLineStacked100
    Case 6
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkersStacked
    Case 7
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkersStacked100
    Case 8
        ch.ChartType = xlAreaStacked
    Case 9
        ch.ChartType = xlAreaStacked100
    Case 10
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnStacked
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    Case 11
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnStacked: ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    Case 12
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnStacked
        ch.ChartGroups(1).Overlap = 50
    Case 13
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnStacked
        ch.ChartGroups(1).GapWidth = 80
    Case 14
        ch.ChartType = xlLineStacked
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).MarkerStyle = xlMarkerStyleCircle
    Case 15
        ch.ChartType = xlLineMarkersStacked
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).MarkerStyle = xlMarkerStyleNone
    Case 16
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnStacked
        ch.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.ChartType
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).ChartType
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Type
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.ChartGroups(1).Overlap
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ch.ChartGroups(1).GapWidth
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Tried = "ok " & Mid(s, 2)
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 16
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
